استكبروا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْبَرُوا (istakbarū) /is.tak.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# اُسْتُكْبِرُوا (ustukbirū) /us.tuk.bi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# اِسْتَكْبِرُوا (istakbirū) /is.tak.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
